## Summary

What does this change, and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Research or documentation
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Build, packaging, or CI

## Validation

How did you test or verify this? Include commands, hardware, and results.

## Documentation

- [ ] I updated the relevant research note, ADR, or user documentation.
- [ ] I added or updated tests where practical.
- [ ] I removed secrets, private screen content, and personal data from logs and captures.

## Licensing

- [ ] I have read `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] I understand the project is GPL-3.0-or-later and that copied code from incompatible licenses is not acceptable.
- [ ] Every commit carries a `Signed-off-by:` line (`git commit -s`).
